children: Overview
Consumer electronics maker's H1 revenue rose 16.4% yr/yr to HK$63.8 bln
Net income attributable to owners of the parent grew 40.2% yr/yr
Outlook
Company expects completion of air-conditioning business acquisition in Q4 2026
TCL sees ongoing demand for large-sized TVs and AI-powered devices supporting future growth
Result Drivers
GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION & PRODUCT MIX - Co said revenue growth was driven by deeper global distribution and shift to mid-to-high-end products
MINI LED & LARGE TV SHIPMENTS - Increased shipments of Mini LED and large-sized TVs led to higher average selling prices and gross profit
OPERATING EFFICIENCY & EXPENSE CONTROL - Improved efficiency driven by AI and digital tools, with expense ratio at 11.7%, supported profitability

Wall Street's median 12-month price target for TCL Electronics Holdings Ltd is HK$18.08, about 15.5% above its August 27 closing price of HK$15.65
